hero.title: Built in Cambodia,
hero.subtitle: ResuMate started with a simple frustration: too many talented students were paying strangers on Facebook just to get a resume that they couldn't even edit afterward.

story.label: Why we started
story.title: The $2.99 problem nobody
story.p1: Every year, thousands of students graduate from universities across Cambodia ready to start their careers. But there is a quiet barrier between them and their first job application: the resume.
story.p2: Without an affordable, locally built tool, most job seekers turn to informal resume writers on Facebook and Telegram paying two to six dollars each time, waiting days for a draft, and ending up with a file they cannot edit themselves when something needs to change.
story.quote: "We didn't want to build another resume tool. We wanted to build the tool we wished existed when we were applying for our first jobs."
story.p3: That's why ResuMate exists free to start, bilingual, AI assisted, and always yours to keep, edit, and reuse. And now it goes further: not just building a resume, but helping you understand exactly how ready you are for any specific job you apply to.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.title: Make a great resume accessible to every
mission.subtitle: We believe where you went to university or how confident your English is shouldn't decide whether you get a fair shot at a job interview.

cards.title: Affordable for everyone
cards.desc: A generous free plan and Pro pricing built around what a Cambodian student can actually afford not US software pricing.

cards.title: Built for two languages
cards.desc: Read every instruction in Khmer or English, while your resume content stays in English exactly what employers expect.

cards.title: Beyond the resume
cards.desc: Most platforms stop once the resume is done. ResuMate continues analyzing job ads, matching your skills, and preparing you for the interview.

items.title: Free should mean free
items.desc: No surprise paywall before downloading. Our free plan gives a real, usable resume not a teaser that locks the PDF until you pay.

items.title: Built for Cambodia first
items.desc: Every template, price, and payment method (KHQR, ABA Pay) is designed around how Cambodians actually work and pay not adapted from a US product.

items.title: Guidance over judgment
items.desc: If you have no work experience, we don't leave you stuck with a blank form. We show you exactly what counts and help you write it in professional English.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.desc: Your resume is always editable, exportable, and under your control never locked into our platform. Download it once and it is yours forever.

founder.label: Who's behind it
founder.title: A solo project,
founder.name: Song Kimvisal
founder.bio: A Bachelor of Software Engineering student in Multimedia at Limkokwing University Cambodia, building ResuMate as a final year project rooted in a real problem seen across Cambodian university campuses and a belief that good design, AI assistance, and career readiness tools should not be reserved for expensive Western platforms.

tips: Use an email and phone number you actually check recruiters reach out here first.
Start each bullet with an action verb and add a number where you can, e.g. "increased sales by 20%".
List your most recent degree first, and only include your GPA if it's strong.
Pick skills that match the job description quality beats a long list.
Read your resume out loud once before saving. It's the fastest way to catch typos.
